Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires are on the field. The fielding team is seen in a huddle along the boundary line with Babar Azam giving some final instructions before they take their respective positions. Devon Conway and Rachin Ravindra to open the innings for New Zealand. Haris Rauf will have the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, the players are off to a break before the chase begins. Pakistan have managed to put 345 on the board with a good batting display from most of their batters. The Kiwis have a challenge ahead of them with the pace attack of Pakistan. We will see Kane Williamson out in the middle after a long time off from international cricket. Devon Conway is also back in the team. It will be an interesting chase as the Black Caps will put up a good fight for the win. Grab a cup of coffee and join us in a while as we bring you the coverage of the run chase in a while.

Mohammad Rizwan is in for a chat. He says that he is satisfied with this hundred. Mentions that he is happy with the support received here in India. Adds that the support is similar to what they receive back home. On his batting position, he says that it is difficult but he is ready to bat wherever the team needs. Says that Saud Shakeel has been in form since last year and played a classy innings. On Babar Azam, he says that he has good chemistry and they try to rotate the strike,

New Zealand had a very strong start as Matt Henry and Mitchell Santner gave them two very early breakthroughs by dismissing the openers. After that, there was a dry spell with the bowlers going wicketless for a brief period of time. Mitchell Santner struck again dismissing the opposition skipper followed by James Neesham and Lockie Ferguson who took the other two wickets. The bowlers failed to take quick wickets and did not stick to the right lengths which allowed strong partnerships to be made. Trent Boult was not given an over which was quite shocking as he is one of their best opening bowlers. Matt Henry bowled really well in the opening phases. 8 bowlers were tired out by the Kiwis and Mitchell Santner stood out clinching 2 wickets. The target for the Black Caps is 346.

Pakistan was off to a slow start after two very early wickets as the openers, Imam-ul-Haq and his new partner Abdullah Shafique were dismissed pretty early on. After that, the star duo, Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan put up a very strong partnership and took the bowlers apart. Both of them reached their half-centuries before Babar Azam was dismissed for 80 runs. It was now, Saud Shakeel who supported Rizwan to take the batting innings deep. Mohammad Rizwan reached his century and retired back to the pavilion bringing out Agha Salman. Saud Shakeel accelerated the score with Agha Salman supporting him as he reached his half-century. The form of Shakeel will give some confidence to the team's middle order. Agha Salman, Iftikhar Ahmed, and Shadab Khan gave a strong end to the innings and put 345 on the board.

That is it from the first innings. Pakistan has managed to reach a very respectable total after a relatively slow start to the innings. New Zealand however could not capitalize on their strong start and were put under pressure by the batters. A fantastic hundred from Mohammad Rizwan along with a few half-centuries made sure Pakistan reach 345.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar is pitchside. He starts by saying that the pitch has been generally good for batting. Adds that this pitch looks like a road and the ball will come on nicely onto the bat. Reckons that there will be a lot of boundaries and the outfield is quick as well. Feels that there might be a bit of turn for the wrist spinners.

New Zealand's stand-in skipper Tom Latham starts by informing that Kane Williamson will bat later in the game but will not participate in the field. Mentions that these games are to acclimatise to the conditions and get used to the heat. Feels that it is important to adapt as quickly as possible. States that they would have batted first as well but hopes to get early inroads with the new ball. Shares that Tim Southee is not here but most guys are available for this game.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, says that they will bat first. He says that the pitch looks good and will try to assess the conditions to put runs on the board. He adds that the team is excited to play in the World Cup and is a good opportunity to get used to the conditions. He mentions that he will try to utilize all the 15 players in this warm-up match

They are coming into the World Cup with a series win against Bangladesh in sub-continental conditions and with a lot of confidence. Kane Williamson is back in the squad after a long injury that he sustained in the IPL earlier this year. He will try to make the most of this warm-up match and get some game time to practice.
